name: review_bounded_analyses

config.A1: shared held-out records, both deterministic methods
config.A2: chronological cut sensitivity, natural arm, 7 cuts

RevReproNaturalAucpr.desc: detector AUC-PR on the natural held-out slice, recomputed from the score dump

RevReproSyntheticAucpr.desc: detector AUC-PR on the synthetic held-out slice, recomputed from the score dump

RevSharedRecords.desc: records held out by BOTH arms

RevSharedPrevalence.desc: attack prevalence of the shared held-out records

RevSharedAttacks.desc: attacks among the shared held-out records

RevSharedDetectorNaturalAucpr.desc: detector AUC-PR on shared records, natural arm

RevSharedEcodNaturalAucpr.desc: ECOD AUC-PR on shared records, natural arm

RevSharedDetectorNaturalNormLift.desc: detector normalized lift on shared records, natural

RevSharedEcodNaturalNormLift.desc: ECOD normalized lift on shared records, natural

RevSharedDetectorSyntheticAucpr.desc: detector AUC-PR on shared records, synthetic arm

RevSharedEcodSyntheticAucpr.desc: ECOD AUC-PR on shared records, synthetic arm

RevSharedDetectorSyntheticNormLift.desc: detector normalized lift on shared records, synthetic

RevSharedEcodSyntheticNormLift.desc: ECOD normalized lift on shared records, synthetic

RevSharedInversionSurvives.desc: 1 if ECOD>detector natural AND detector>ECOD synthetic on the SHARED records

RevSplitEcodWins.desc: cut points where ECOD exceeds the detector (natural arm)

RevBranchCombinedAucpr.desc: Combined AUC-PR on the natural held-out slice

RevBranchCombinedAucroc.desc: Combined AUC-ROC on the natural held-out slice

RevBranchTailOnlyAucpr.desc: TailOnly AUC-PR on the natural held-out slice

RevBranchTailOnlyAucroc.desc: TailOnly AUC-ROC on the natural held-out slice

RevBranchAuxOnlyAucpr.desc: AuxOnly AUC-PR on the natural held-out slice

RevBranchAuxOnlyAucroc.desc: AuxOnly AUC-ROC on the natural held-out slice

RevTailCarriesCombined.desc: 1 if tail-only AUC-PR matches combined within 0.01

notes: answers the fresh review's identification, split-sensitivity and branch-discrimination objections from archived per-record scores
